name: Gragas
title: the Rabble Rouser

Q.name: Barrel Roll
Q.description: Gragas rolls a cask that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing between 80/120/160/200/240 + 0.8×AP magic damage and (80/120/160/200/240 + 0.8×AP) × 1.5 magic damage and Slowing for between 40/45/50/55/60 and 60/67.5/75/82.5/90% for 2 seconds. The damage and Slow increase with time the cask spent before exploding. Gragas can Recast to detonate the cask early.
Q.summary: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time. Enemies struck by the blast have their Move Speed slowed.

W.name: Drunken Rage
W.description: Gragas samples his brew, reducing incoming damage by (10/14/18/22/26 + 0.04×AP) × 0.01 for 2.5 seconds and empowering his next Attack to deal an additional 20/50/80/110/140 + 0.7×AP plus 7% max Health magic damage to the target and surrounding enemies.
W.summary: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.

E.name: Body Slam
E.description: Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, Knocking Up nearby enemies for 1 second and dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.6×AP magic damage to them. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 40% if Gragas collides with an enemy.
E.summary: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.

R.name: Explosive Cask
R.description: Gragas hurls his cask, dealing 200/300/400 + 0.8×AP magic damage and Knocking Away enemies from the impact zone.
R.summary: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.

Passive.name: Happy Hour
Passive.description: Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.
Passive.summary: Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Body-slamming bruiser/mage who engages with E knock-up and repositions enemies with R. Barrel Q pokes and passive heals sustain him.

curve.items: strong – AP burst or tank engage

profile.curveNote: Combo needs E and Q (and W).
